Laura (Partnerships): Kicking off Forge Systems preview thread. NDA signed and countersigned. Need to lock bench windows + telemetry schema. @Riley can you confirm windows/creds?
Riley - Forge Systems: Confirmed — lab access Wed–Fri next week (UTC). Will share image + SSH creds by EOD Mon, plus power telemetry endpoint. NDA copy attached to the email I sent.
Sam (Eng-ML): Great. We'll run throughput + p95/p99 latency + memory-profiling. Target seq lengths: 512 and 2048 as baseline.
Diego (Bench): Please include fp16 and 4-bit quant runs. Capture per-token p50/p95/p99 and tail latencies. Also try cold-start (empty KV) and warm-cache runs. If possible enable driver perf counters and power meter.
Riley - Forge Systems: We can provide power telemetry via a prometheus endpoint (will hand out a read-only token). Note our current driver limits batch size to 8 for models >30B — might affect large-batch tests.
Laura (Partnerships): Quick proposal for success criteria for this preview: <=50ms p95 for 512 tokens @ batch=1 fp16; end-to-end throughput within 2x of our A100 reference for 2048 sequences. If we miss, document delta and plan fallback (quantized variants / smaller checkpoints).
Sam (Eng-ML): Ack. We'll instrument KV cache, prefix caching, and measure GPU utilization. Plan to run the redwood harness and the new memory profiler. Example command we'll run on the lab image:
```bash
redwood-bench --model /opt/models/forge-gpt-v1 --seq-len 512,2048 --batch 1,4,8 --quant fp16,int4 --profile mem,gpu --out /tmp/results.json
```
Diego (Bench): I'll own result ingest + eval prompt set. Sam — where should I upload artifacts?
Sam (Eng-ML): Upload path: gs://redwood-priv/bench/forge-preview/2479999999. Added perms group redwood-benchers@redwood.internal and set lifecycle to 90d.
CI Bot: deploy-bot: test cluster created for run id 3742 — attach run:forge-2479999999 tag to all artifacts.
Laura (Partnerships): Action items recap: Riley to share creds + telemetry token by Mon EOD; Sam to run harness Wed (start of lab window); Diego to upload results and draft a short findings doc; Partnerships will prepare a partner summary for PR if we meet criteria. I'll send a calendar invite now. :thumbsup:
